instructions.purpose: Read the connectors (external tool servers) the assistant knows for this user. Call it before changing or removing a connector, to get its id.

tool.name: list-connectors
tool.description: Returns serverConnectors and userConnectors. serverConnectors are set up by the server's operator for everyone: id and description; they are read-only and cannot be changed or removed here. userConnectors are the user's own: id, kind (mcp or utcp: the server's protocol), url, description, plainChats and status: pending_add (waiting for the user's approval, not usable yet), active (usable), or pending_removal (still usable, waiting for the user's approval of the removal). Takes no parameters.

usage_rules.rule: Call it whenever the user asks which connectors they have, and before update-connector or remove-connector
Match the user's words to a connector by its id, url or description
When a server connector is asked to be changed or removed, say it is set up server-wide and cannot be changed here

example.context: User says: "what servers are you connected to?"
